title: Musify joins the creative apps list
summary:
A community music app joined the showcase, while link previews and footer terms got some attention.

Musify was added to the website’s creative apps list and README. The community-built music app uses the Pollinations API for an AI music assistant, voice commands, and playlist creation.

The default SEO image now uses an absolute URL, so link previews can resolve the Pollinations banner.

A compliance section was added to the Terms & Conditions text in the website footer.
